question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Systematically
solution:
The correct answer is '**Haphazardly**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**systematically**" refers to doing something in a systematic order or methodical way, where there is a clear plan or system in place (सुव्यवस्थित तरीके से).
